title: 07. Chug, Chug! The Fast Train
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Ding, ding, ding! The crossing barrier slowly comes down. Then a long train races toward them from far away and zooms past! Hori's ears perk up. Wow! How does such a long train go so fast? Chug, chug! The fast train is leaving!
Dad, where is that train rushing to? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Dad's hand. Dad smiles. Shall we visit the place where trains live, the railway station? Bori can come, too!

People come and go in the wide station. A big train stands beside a long platform. Hello! Have you come to learn about trains? A train driver in a blue uniform and a cap waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

Trains can't travel on just any road. They run on these two rails. The driver points to the shiny tracks. The wheels fit the rails and carry the train forward. Bori looks carefully. Two rails run side by side all the way!

Remember the crossing we saw earlier? When a train passes, the bell rings and the barrier comes down. The driver gestures. Trains are heavy and can't stop quickly, so people and cars wait while the train passes first. Hori nods. I'll always wait when the barrier is down!

They follow the driver onto the train. Inside is a room-like passenger car, with rows of soft seats. Several cars are joined together to make one long train. Looking out of the window, Hori calls, Chug, chug! The fast train is leaving!

At the front is the driver's cab, full of buttons and controls. This is where I move and stop the train. On the next track stands a silver KTX train with a pointed nose. That high-speed train goes very, very fast. Its pointed nose cuts through the air! Hori's mouth falls open.

Would Hori like to be a train driver? The driver gently settles him into the big seat, where he can see everything. Together, they hold the control and sound the horn. Honk! A loud sound rings out. Hori's tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. Chug, chug! The fast train is leaving!

Now it's really time to leave! The driver sits in the cab, and the doors close. Honk! The train moves gently, then faster and faster, gliding out of the station. Hori and Bori wave from the platform. Goodbye! Have a safe trip!

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. Trains run on two rails, with passenger cars joined together. The driver works in the front cab, and we must wait at crossings! Hori smiles at the sky. Chug, chug! The fast train is leaving!
